fractionalCompoundSweep.result: All matched independently computed rational expected cents; execution would throw immediately on any mismatch.
fractionalCompoundSweep.expectedCentsAlgorithm: For principal cents c and growth a/b, numerator=BigInt(c*a), denominator=BigInt(b); expected cents=(2*numerator+denominator)/(2*denominator), using integer division. Compare actual futureValue with Number(expected cents)/100. This exercises rational-exponent square roots and exact half-cent ties without Decimal as the expected-value oracle.
